turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Good afternoon, please have a seat and tell me what brings you in today.

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: I have been very tired for about two weeks and I get dizzy when I stand up quickly.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: I have taken your weight and temperature, and the results are on the chart.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: How long have you been feeling this way, and does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: It comes and goes, mostly in the afternoon, and resting seems to help a little.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Shall I bring in the paperwork for the blood test before you leave today?

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: I would like to check your blood pressure and listen to your heart now.

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: I take one tablet for my blood pressure every morning and a vitamin most days.
